correctness.rationale: The vertex action is faithful. For n≥3 every automorphism takes r to r^a with a a unit, since all elements outside the rotation subgroup have order two and r has order n. The image of f must be outside that subgroup and every resulting pair (a,b) is an automorphism by the presentation. The kernel of conjugation on the represented subgroup is precisely its centralizer, so the quotient is the image of that map, not automatically the full abstract group. In the convention r:i↦i+1, f:i↦−i, the trace on V of r^j f is the number of solutions of 2i=j modulo n and the trace on W is twice that. For even n, odd b sends f from trace 4 to trace 0; at n=4 this already rules out the shift f↦rf. For every eligible b choose 2c=b and directly conjugate r and f by the permutation i↦ai+c on both copies, giving exactly the claimed automorphism. This proves sufficiency, the odd case, and the even order nφ(n)/2. It concerns the full unitary normalizer of the stated two copies of V, not either a literal vertices-plus-edges action or a restricted error group. The frozen artifacts/verify.py was inspected, not executed; the finite check is not needed for the proof.
